// TEMPORARY capture script (not committed to superbee-hosted): records the /sync/v1 golden
// exchanges the superbee OSS CLI fake and core decoders are checked against. It runs the real
// gateway app (`createApp`) through the sync write fixture; only the identity issuer is faked.
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { fixture, create, replace, json, BINDING } from "./support/sync-v1-fixture.js";
import { GRAMMAR_HEADERS } from "./support/hosted-transport-exchanges.js";

const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!;
const RECREATE = "X-Superbee-Recreate";
const ids = {
  create: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000001",
  createExists: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000002",
  replace: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000003",
  replaceConflict: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000004",
  delete: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000005",
  deleteAgain: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000006",
  createTombstoned: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000007",
  absent: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000008",
  capacity: "4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-000000000009",
};

test("capture /sync/v1 golden exchanges", async (t) => {
  assert.ok(OUT, "CAPTURE_OUT");
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const f = await fixture(t);
  const index: any[] = [];
  const record = async (
    name: string,
    description: string,
    rows: string[],
    route: string,
    body: unknown,
    options: Parameters<typeof f.sync>[2] = {},
  ) => {
    const write = ["create", "replace", "delete", "outcome"].includes(route);
    const requestHeaders: Record<string, string> = { "content-type": "application/json" };
    if (write && options.requestId !== null) requestHeaders["x-superbee-write-request"] = options.requestId ?? ids.absent;
    if (write && options.binding !== null) requestHeaders["x-superbee-checkout"] = options.binding ?? BINDING;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(options.headers ?? {})) requestHeaders[k.toLowerCase()] = v;
    const response = await f.sync(route, body, {
      ...options,
      ...(write ? {} : { requestId: null, binding: null }),
      ...(write && options.requestId === undefined ? { requestId: ids.absent } : {}),
    });
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const header of GRAMMAR_HEADERS) {
      const value = response.headers.get(header);
      if (value !== null) headers[header] = value;
    }
    const text = await response.text();
    const exchange = {
      name,
      description,
      route: `/sync/v1/${route}`,
      rows,
      request: { method: "POST", headers: requestHeaders, body: typeof body === "string" ? body : JSON.stringify(body) },
      response: { status: response.status, headers, body: text, truncated: false },
    };
    writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(exchange, null, 2)}\n`);
    index.push({ name, file: `${name}.json`, route: exchange.route, rows, status: response.status });
    return text === "" || route === "snapshot" ? text : JSON.parse(text);
  };
  const base = f.versions["notes.a"];

  await record("whoami-200", "Who the bearer is on the sync surface.", ["whoami 200"], "whoami", {});
  await record("bundles-200", "The bundles the bearer may sync.", ["bundles 200"], "bundles", {});
  await record("capabilities-200", "The working copy's capabilities for a writable bundle.", ["capabilities 200"], "capabilities", { bundleId: "notes.a" });
  const heads = await record("heads-200", "The heads listing: one document.", ["heads 200"], "heads", { bundleId: "notes.a" });
  await record("heads-304", "The heads listing unchanged since the digest sent.", ["heads 304"], "heads", { bundleId: "notes.a", ifNoneMatch: heads.digest });
  await record("snapshot-200", "The whole bundle as one NDJSON snapshot.", ["snapshot 200 complete"], "snapshot", { bundleId: "notes.a" });
  await record("read-200-ok", "documents.read.v1 of a present document.", ["read 200 ok"], "read", { bundleId: "notes.a", documentId: "notes/one" });
  await record("read-200-document-not-found", "documents.read.v1 of an absent document.", ["read 200 document_not_found"], "read", { bundleId: "notes.a", documentId: "notes/absent" });
  await record("read-200-bundle-not-found", "documents.read.v1 in a bundle the bearer cannot reach.", ["read 200 bundle_not_found"], "read", { bundleId: "nope.a", documentId: "notes/one" });
  await record("read-400-invalid-input", "A read input the schema refuses.", ["refusal 400 invalid_input"], "read", { bundleId: "notes.a", documentId: "notes/one", extra: true });
  await record("read-401-unauthenticated", "A read without a valid bearer.", ["refusal 401 unauthenticated"], "read", { bundleId: "notes.a", documentId: "notes/one" }, { bearer: "not-a-token" });

  const created = await record("create-200-ok", "A create that commits.", ["200 ok"], "create", create("notes/two", "two"), { requestId: ids.create });
  await record("outcome-200-committed-create", "The committed create, looked up by identity.", ["200 committed"], "outcome", create("notes/two", "two"), { requestId: ids.create });
  await record("create-200-document-exists", "A create of a present document.", ["200 document_exists"], "create", create("notes/one", "dup"), { requestId: ids.createExists });
  const replaced = await record("replace-200-ok", "A replace at the served version that commits.", ["200 ok"], "replace", replace(base, "one edited"), { requestId: ids.replace });
  await record("replace-200-version-conflict", "A replace at a stale version.", ["200 version_conflict"], "replace", replace(base, "stale"), { requestId: ids.replaceConflict });
  await record("outcome-200-refused-replace", "The recorded refusal, looked up by identity.", ["200 refused"], "outcome", replace(base, "stale"), { requestId: ids.replaceConflict });
  const remove = (expectedVersion: string, documentId = "notes/two") => ({ bundleId: "notes.a", documentId, expectedVersion });
  const deleted = await record("delete-200-ok", "A delete at the served version: a tombstone.", ["200 ok"], "delete", remove(created.data.version), { requestId: ids.delete });
  await record("outcome-200-committed-delete", "The committed delete, looked up by identity: no content.", ["200 committed"], "outcome", remove(created.data.version), { requestId: ids.delete });
  await record("delete-200-unchanged", "A new identity deleting at the same base: unchanged, naming the tombstone.", ["200 ok"], "delete", remove(created.data.version), { requestId: ids.deleteAgain });
  await record("create-200-version-conflict-tombstone", "A create over a tombstone that does not acknowledge it.", ["200 version_conflict"], "create", create("notes/two", "again"), { requestId: ids.createTombstoned });
  await record("outcome-200-absent", "An identity the host never recorded.", ["200 absent"], "outcome", create("notes/never"), { requestId: ids.absent });
  await record("write-400-invalid-input", "A write body the schema refuses.", ["400"], "replace", { ...replace(replaced.data.version, "x"), extra: true }, { requestId: ids.capacity });
  await record("write-400-missing-identity", "A write without its request identity.", ["400"], "create", create("notes/x"), { requestId: null });
  void deleted;
  void RECREATE;

  const source = execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
  writeFileSync(
    path.join(OUT, "index.json"),
    `${JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, source: `Holaxis-ai/superbee-hosted ${source}`, exchanges: index }, null, 2)}\n`,
  );
});

test("capture the capacity refusal", async (t) => {
  const f = await fixture(t, { capacity: { maximumRequests: 10 } });
  let last: Response | undefined;
  let n = 0;
  let requestId = "";
  for (; n < 12; n++) {
    requestId = `4a2f9c1e-8b3d-4e6f-9a1b-1000000000${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    last = await f.sync("create", create(`n/${n}`), { requestId });
    if (last.status !== 200) break;
  }
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const header of GRAMMAR_HEADERS) {
    const value = last!.headers.get(header);
    if (value !== null) headers[header] = value;
  }
  const exchange = {
    name: "create-429-request-capacity",
    description: "A create the bundle's sync capacity refuses before dispatch (after earlier creates used the bound).",
    route: "/sync/v1/create",
    rows: ["429 request_capacity"],
    request: { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "x-superbee-write-request": requestId, "x-superbee-checkout": BINDING }, body: JSON.stringify(create(`n/${n}`)) },
    response: { status: last!.status, headers, body: await last!.text(), truncated: false },
  };
  writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, "create-429-request-capacity.json"), `${JSON.stringify(exchange, null, 2)}\n`);
});

// ---- /sync/v1/export, captured from superbee-hosted d728d471 (PR 650) with the same fixture. ----
// TEMPORARY capture (not committed): /sync/v1/export golden exchanges in the hosted-sync-v1 format.
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fixture } from "./support/sync-v1-fixture.js";
import { GRAMMAR_HEADERS } from "./support/hosted-transport-exchanges.js";

const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!;
test("capture /sync/v1/export exchanges", async (t) => {
  assert.ok(OUT);
  const f = await fixture(t);
  const index: any[] = [];
  const record = async (name: string, description: string, rows: string[], body: unknown, options: any = {}) => {
    const response = await f.sync("export", body, { requestId: null, binding: null, ...options });
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const header of [...GRAMMAR_HEADERS, "content-disposition"]) {
      const value = response.headers.get(header);
      if (value !== null) headers[header] = value;
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer());
    const binary = headers["content-type"] === "application/zip";
    const exchange = {
      name,
      description,
      route: "/sync/v1/export",
      rows,
      request: { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: typeof body === "string" ? body : JSON.stringify(body) },
      response: {
        status: response.status,
        headers,
        ...(binary ? { bodyBase64: Buffer.from(bytes).toString("base64") } : { body: new TextDecoder().decode(bytes) }),
        truncated: false,
      },
    };
    writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(exchange, null, 2)}\n`);
    index.push({ name, file: `${name}.json`, route: exchange.route, rows, status: response.status });
  };
  await record("export-200", "The portable export of a readable bundle: a store-only zip (body base64; exportedAt varies per run).", ["export 200"], { bundleId: "notes.a" });
  await record("export-404-bundle-not-found", "An export of a bundle the bearer cannot reach.", ["refusal 404 bundle_not_found"], { bundleId: "nope.a" });
  await record("export-400-invalid-input", "An export input the schema refuses.", ["refusal 400 invalid_input"], { bundleId: "notes.a", extra: true });
  await record("export-401-unauthenticated", "An export without a valid bearer.", ["refusal 401 unauthenticated"], { bundleId: "notes.a" }, { bearer: "not-a-token" });
  writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, "export-index.json"), `${JSON.stringify(index, null, 2)}\n`);
});
